metadata.description: Bands of the top layer inside the bilayer, extracted from the explicit bilayer bands with the weights P_mn = |<phi_m|psi_n>|^2 of the top-layer states phi_m (ML_bot moved to the top position by symmetry) on the bilayer states psi_n (bands 1-20); kept states: P_mn >= 0.05, S_m = sum of their weights; E_m = sum_kept P_mn E_n / S_m; attributable if S_m >= 0.9 and all the kept states have the occupation of m (not attributable: NFE states around Gamma; there E_m is the mean over the kept conduction states); weights averaged over degenerate groups. Compared with the bands of the top layer alone (= ML_bot). Bilayer and layer energies from gw_bands.json (KS = PBE bands run, QP = G0W0 PPA interpolated by ypp).
metadata.units: path coordinate in 2pi/a; energies in eV, zero at the KS VBM of each system (k = 18 grid)
